planets.name: NGTS-35 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of NGTS-35 with a 732-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: NGTS-35 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around NGTS-35. Its orbit and size follow Kendall et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
